title: BACnet MS/TP Driver Configuration
description: Per-driver-type schema for `type: bacnet_mstp` entries (FR-DF-004, Sprint P7). Unlike `bacnet_ip`, this driver supervises a standalone C daemon (xedge/drivers/bacnet/mstp_daemon/, linked against the vendored third_party/bacnet-stack) that owns the actual MS/TP token-passing lifecycle for one RS-485 port. MVP scope matches bacnet_ip: ReadProperty polling only, master node role only, no COV subscriptions, no device discovery.

port.description: Serial device for this driver instance's RS-485 port, e.g. '/dev/ttyUSB0'. Passed to the daemon as --iface.

mac_address.description: This xEdge instance's own MS/TP MAC address on this RS-485 segment (must be unique on the segment).

device_instance.description: This xEdge instance's own BACnet device instance number (must be unique on the BACnet network).

baud_rate.description: RS-485 baud rate; must match every other node on the segment.

max_info_frames.description: Max frames this node sends before passing the token, per the MS/TP spec's Max_Info_Frames property.

max_master.description: Highest MAC address this node will poll for during token passing, per the MS/TP spec's Max_Master property.

request_timeout_seconds.description: Per-request (ReadProperty) timeout waiting on the daemon's IPC response.

daemon_path.description: Path to (or name on PATH of) the compiled xedge_bacnet_mstp_daemon binary.

scan_rate_ms.description: 100ms minimum sampling interval, matching the other polling drivers.

device_instance.description: Target device's BACnet device instance number.

mac_address.description: Target device's MS/TP MAC address on this RS-485 segment.
